# Publish your trust center

Go from nothing to a published trust center in an afternoon, with you in full
control of access.

1. **[Create a trust center](/getting-started)** - sign in and enter your legal name,
   product, and primary domain. This provisions a vendor and a private owner token.
2. **[Brand it](/vendors/branding)** - your logo, colors, headline. TrustMCP stays invisible.
3. **[Upload evidence](/vendors/artifacts)** - SOC 2, pentest, ISO, COI, DPA, SBOM…
4. **[Declare attestations](/vendors/attestations)** - machine-readable claims.
5. **Verify a domain** - confirm you control where you publish ([see below](#verify-your-domain)).
6. **Add your discovery record** - host `/.well-known/trustmcp.json` on your domain
   (copy it from the app, or proxy `/api/discovery/{vendor_id}`).
7. **Publish** - your public trust center goes live.
8. **[Handle access](/vendors/access-and-approvals)** - approve, scope, revoke; or set
   **[auto-release policies](/vendors/auto-release)**.

You answered the questionnaire once - by publishing.

## Verify your domain

In **Domains**, add a domain and complete **one** challenge to confirm you control it:

- **DNS TXT** - add `_trustmcp-challenge.<domain>` with the shown value, or
- **`.well-known`** - host the value at `https://<domain>/.well-known/trustmcp-challenge.txt`.

Click **Verify**. This proves you own the domain you publish under - the content of your
evidence stays self-asserted, and customers verify it themselves. Verification is free,
domain-bound, and reflected at `GET /v1/mark/{vendor_id}`, which consumers can check
without a key.

## Auth & accounts

Sign in with **GitHub**, **Google**, or an **email sign-in link** (which verifies your
address). See the [auth setup](https://github.com/coverbasedev/trustmcp/blob/main/docs/auth-setup.md)
for configuring providers and SMTP.
